verdict.rationale: Blaxel's filesystem docs say developers can read, write, list, and delete files inside a sandbox from the SDK, MCP server, or REST API. That clearly covers the core of the story; upload and download are at most implied by read/write. missing for 10: explicit upload/download (e.g. binary or large-file transfer) documentation, SDK code-level detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
